method.angles: pose-bone rotation relative to its parent compared with rest, in the bone's local axes (XYZ Euler for components); Neck+Head = Head relative to Chest (X pitch, + = down; Y yaw)
method.upper_arm: change of the UpperArm direction relative to Chest, as the abduction angle in Chest's frontal plane (spec 14.8 G1c)
method.shoulder_below_rest: UpperArm head height in Chest space below its rest value
method.breath: Breath offset from rest relative to Chest, length
method.pole_tips: height = lowest vertex of the evaluated pole; travel = horizontal path of the rest-lowest vertex per continuous run with height < 10 mm
method.feet: Foot_*/Toes_* head world drift and world rotation vs rest; Hips the same
method.clearance: vertices of A with signed distance >= 0 to closed mesh B at rest and < -1 mm at the frame (BVH nearest + face normal); both directions
method.pack_seat: Gear_Backpack vertices within 30 mm of each torso garment at rest, each bound to its nearest rest surface point (triangle + barycentric); per frame the signed distance to that same deformed point (along its deformed triangle normal) minus the rest value; limits -8 / +5 mm
method.rest: pose cleared, no action (identical to frame 1 and 121 of ready_to_go)

defaults_in_author_script.upperarm: counter-rotates the full Shoulder rotation (orientation kept relative to Chest)
defaults_in_author_script.interpolation: smootherstep between keys, baked on every frame 1-121, LINEAR keys
